aliases.name: Carberb
aliases.analyst_notes: Legacy corpus spelling retained only for lookup compatibility; canonicalized to Carberp after actor-specific review.

actor.description: Group-IB describes Carberp as a financially motivated hacking group that operated a banking botnet, targeted financial institutions and banks, and used the Carberp banking Trojan for large-scale fraud.
actor.analyst_notes: Do not conflate the Carberp criminal group with the Carberp banking Trojan, which was also used by other criminal groups.

attribution.assessment: Group-IB identifies Carberp as a criminal hacking group focused on financial theft; no state sponsorship is asserted.
attribution.analyst_notes: Russian language and early targeting in Russia/CIS are contextual geography, not state sponsorship.

motivations.description: Group-IB lists the group's motivation as Financial and documents theft from banking customers.

diamond_model.adversary: Group-IB describes Carberp as a financially motivated hacking group that operated a banking botnet, targeted financial institutions and banks, and used the Carberp banking Trojan for large-scale fraud.
diamond_model.capability: Carberp banking Trojan / banking botnet operations
diamond_model.victim: Financial sector and banks; Group-IB describes attacks as worldwide.
diamond_model.analyst_notes: Bootstrap model; infrastructure and campaign-level pivots require report review.

regions.name: 全世界
regions.description: Group-IB lists the geography of Carberp attacks as Worldwide.
regions.analyst_notes: Worldwide is source-stated; it does not imply every country was targeted.

sectors.name: 金融
sectors.description: Group-IB lists the financial sector and banks as Carberp targets.

targets.selection_logic: Actor-specific Group-IB investigation only; geography is not reused as sponsorship evidence.
targets.analyst_notes: The prior United States-only target entry came from a community mapping workbook and was replaced by the source-stated worldwide scope.

sources.title: APT Groups and Operations
sources.analyst_notes: Mappings are leads, not definitive attribution; workbook disclaimer applies.

sources.title: carberb
sources.analyst_notes: Repository source; publication metadata requires review.

sources.title: Carberp gang knocked down
sources.analyst_notes: Actor-specific investigation used to correct entity name, criminal sponsorship classification, motivation, and target scope.

key_judgments.statement: Carberp is a financially motivated criminal hacking group; the legacy 'Carberb' spelling and Russia/state/espionage classification are not used as canonical attribution.

gaps: Unknown observation dates must not be replaced by publication dates.
uncertainties: Vendor cluster boundaries may differ from the canonical name used here.

free_text.executive_summary: Carberpの標準化プロファイル。Group-IBのactor-specific調査に基づき、金融目的の犯罪グループとして整理する。
free_text.history: Group-IBは2010〜2012年のCarberp gangの活動と、法執行機関による構成員の摘発を記録している。
free_text.capability_details: Carberp banking Trojanを用いたbanking botnet、認証情報・電子署名鍵の窃取、不正送金。
free_text.targeting_details: 金融機関・銀行を標的とし、Group-IBは攻撃地理をWorldwideと記載している。
free_text.additional_notes: Carberp groupとCarberp malwareを同一entityとして扱わない。Carberbは旧コーパス表記としてのみ保持する。
